sn26.5:1.2: Yo bhikkhave cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe ||
sn26.5:2.1: Yo manasamphassajāya vedanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe ||
sn26.5:2.3: Yo ca kho bhikkhave cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo || pe ||
